info.title: Taicho External API
info.description: Organization-scoped OAuth API for Taicho workspace, content, outreach, publishing, Cascade, Intelligence, webhooks, and durable AI operations.

get.summary: Get plan, usage, and credit wallet
get.description: Returns the workspace's commercial summary — current plan and credit wallet balance — together with recent usage entries for the billing user. Read-only; it changes no reservations or balances.

Returns the subgraph immediately around one node — the node itself plus its directly connected neighbors and edges — for hop-by-hop exploration after brain.overview.get or brain.search. Read-only; requires the brain capability.

Returns a curated overview graph of the workspace's knowledge — projects, active topics, prospects, active personas, and related nodes with their connection counts — sized for a whole-map view. Read-only; requires the brain capability.

Finds knowledge graph nodes whose names or titles match the query (case-insensitive) and returns lightweight results whose ids feed brain.node.get for neighborhood exploration. Read-only; requires the brain capability.

Returns every Cascade contact with email, attributes, timezone, subscription status, linked workspace-contact id, and how many funnels each belongs to. Contacts exist independently of funnels, so people with a funnel count of zero are included.

post.description: Stores a new named plain-text email — literal subject and body text — inside a funnel and returns it with the rendered content field. This only saves copy; it does not send, schedule, or template anything, since external automation reads these records to handle delivery.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

delete.description: Permanently removes one stored plain-text email from the funnel; funnel membership and contacts are unaffected. Deleting an email that is already gone still reports deleted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

patch.description: Replaces the name, subject, and body of a stored plain-text email; all three fields are required and fully overwrite the previous text. Fails when the email does not belong to the given funnel, and editing never triggers any sending.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Creates an empty named funnel — a static list of people plus stored plain-text emails — and returns its summary with zero members and emails. Nothing is scheduled or sent; external automation owns all email delivery.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns every funnel in the workspace, newest first, each with its member count and stored-email count. Funnels are static named lists of people paired with stored plain-text emails; no delivery or scheduling state exists here.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the funnel; its memberships and stored plain-text emails are removed with it, while the contact records themselves survive. Irreversible and requires confirm: true.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.summary: Get a funnel, its people, and its plain-text emails
get.description: Returns one funnel's summary together with its full member roster (contact id, email, attributes, added-at) and every stored plain-text email belonging to it. Read-only; responds 404 when the funnel does not exist.

patch.description: Changes only the funnel's display name and returns the updated summary. Members, stored emails, and ids are untouched.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.summary: Add a person to a funnel
post.description: Enrolls a person into a funnel's static member list, first resolving an existing workspace contact (by id) or creating a canonical one from the email, then importing it as a Cascade contact. Re-adding an existing member is a no-op that returns the current membership; no email is scheduled or sent by this call.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

delete.summary: Remove a person from a funnel
delete.description: Deletes only the membership row linking the contact to the funnel; the contact record and any other funnel memberships are kept. Succeeds even when the membership no longer exists.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Queues a durable background turn of the Taicho assistant: the message is appended to the given persistent chat thread and the agent's tool-using reply is produced asynchronously, readable from the operation result. Reserves credits and responds 202 with an operation handle to poll via operations.get; a repeated Idempotency-Key replays the existing operation. The thread must already exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Creates a new empty conversation thread owned by the calling user, with an optional title and arbitrary metadata, and returns the thread record. No assistant message is generated by this call; use the message-send capability to start the exchange.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

scopeType.description: Conversation space: "main" (default, workspace chat) or "lead" for a prospect-embedded chat.

scopeId.description: Entity id the conversation is embedded in; required when scopeType is "lead".

get.description: Returns the calling user's own assistant conversation threads in this workspace, newest first, as a paginated result (page is zero-based). Threads belonging to other users are never included.

schema.description: Conversation space: "main" (default, workspace chat) or "lead" for a prospect-embedded chat.
Entity id the conversation is embedded in; required when scopeType is "lead".

delete.description: Permanently deletes the thread and its stored message history from agent memory; the removal cannot be undone. Only a thread owned by the calling user can be deleted — anything else responds 404 — and confirm: true is required.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

scopeType.description: Conversation space: "main" (default, workspace chat) or "lead" for a prospect-embedded chat.

scopeId.description: Entity id the conversation is embedded in; required when scopeType is "lead".

get.summary: Get an owned Taicho conversation and messages
get.description: Returns one thread record together with its full recalled message history, in both raw stored form and AI SDK UI message form. Ownership is enforced: a thread owned by any other user responds 404 rather than being revealed.

schema.description: Conversation space: "main" (default, workspace chat) or "lead" for a prospect-embedded chat.
Entity id the conversation is embedded in; required when scopeType is "lead".

get.description: Returns the catalog of subscription plans that can be purchased, with their pricing and included capabilities. The list is not specific to the current workspace; see billing.current.get for the active plan. Read-only.

post.summary: Issue purchased credits to an organization (platform operator)
post.description: Adds purchased credits to any organization's balance, recording the acting operator and a mandatory reason; the grant is permanent once issued. Restricted to human users configured as platform operators by email, and requires explicit confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Stores the supplied contact details, company, optional team size, and requirements for follow-up by the commercial team, and responds 202 with the stored inquiry. It changes no billing state and needs no administrator role, only billing write scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.summary: Get the cross-organization commercial operator overview (platform operator)
get.description: Returns a platform-wide commercial overview spanning every organization, not just the caller's workspace. Read-only, and restricted to human users configured as platform operators by email.

put.description: Directly assigns a plan, and optionally a seat count, to any organization on the platform, recording the acting operator and a mandatory reason. Restricted to human users configured as platform operators by email — workspace administrators of the target organization cannot call it — and requires explicit confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Records an upgrade request for the named plan, with an optional note, for later handling by the commercial team, and responds 202 with the stored request. It changes no billing state itself. Requires a workspace owner or administrator.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns aggregate totals across the content pipeline (ideas and drafts by stage) in a single call, suited to dashboards and quick status checks. Read-only.

post.description: Creates a draft with supplied content attached to an existing content idea and returns it — use this to store hand-written material, whereas content.draft.generate writes the draft with AI. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of content drafts, optionally filtered by lifecycle status (draft, ready, published), content type, source idea, or a free-text search. Read-only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the content draft; there is no undo and anything already published from it on external platforms is untouched. Requires confirm: true and responds 404 if the draft does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns one content draft with its full body, lifecycle status, scheduling and publication fields, and any performance annotations; responds 404 if the id does not exist. Read-only.

patch.description: Applies the supplied fields — body, lifecycle status (draft/ready/published), scheduling, publication metadata, and human performance annotations (engagement level plus insights) — to an existing draft and returns it; responds 404 if the draft does not exist. It records state but publishes nothing externally. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Queues a durable background generation that writes a full draft of the requested contentType from the given idea and stores it as a new content draft. Reserves credits and responds 202 with an operation handle to poll via operations.get; a repeated Idempotency-Key replays the existing operation. For live progress use its streaming sibling content.draft.generate.stream.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Interactive sibling of the durable content.draft.generate operation: it reserves the same credits per run and writes a full draft of the requested contentType from the idea, returning the new draft's id. The SSE progress projection is served at /content/ideas/:id/draft/stream, while this path returns the buffered final result.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Server-sent events projection: `chunk` events while running, then exactly one terminal `result` or `error` event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

200.description: SSE stream of chunk events followed by one terminal result or error event

schema.description: SSE frames; chunk event payloads conform to the chunk schema.

post.summary: Start a creative media generation for a draft
post.description: Reserves credits sized by the chosen template and model, submits an image or video generation for the draft to the external FAL provider, and responds 202 with the run to poll via content.media.run.get. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key; responds 503 when creative generation or storage is not configured.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.summary: List a draft's creative media templates, runs, and assets
get.description: Returns the creative media templates available for the draft (each with its eligible models), the draft's generation runs, and its produced assets. Reading also reconciles a few still-active runs against the provider, so run statuses may advance as a side effect; nothing new is generated.

post.summary: Select a generated asset for a draft
post.description: Marks one previously generated asset as the draft's chosen asset for its role (deselecting any other asset in that role) and returns it; responds 404 if the asset does not exist or belongs to another draft. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Generates content variations while streaming progress, then queues an Audience Resonance run for the candidate set.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.summary: Run a draft resonance experiment (interactive) (SSE stream)
post.description: Server-sent events projection: `chunk` events while running, then exactly one terminal `result` or `error` event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

200.description: SSE stream of chunk events followed by one terminal result or error event

schema.description: SSE frames; chunk event payloads conform to the chunk schema.

get.summary: Get a draft's latest resonance experiment
get.description: Returns the most recent resonance experiment started for the draft via the content.draft.resonance.experiment stream — its job status, result payload, error, and creation time — or latest: null when the draft has never run one. Read-only.

post.description: Creates a content idea node with a title, description, and rationale, optionally linked to the topics and research items that motivated it, and returns it. The idea starts in the unrefined "idea" status. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of content ideas, optionally filtered by status (idea vs. refined), priority, or a free-text search over titles. Read-only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the content idea; there is no undo. Requires confirm: true and responds 404 if the idea does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns one content idea including its rationale and, once refined, its outline, key points, and suggested citations; responds 404 if the id does not exist. Read-only.

patch.description: Applies the supplied fields — including status and the refinement artifacts (outline, key points, suggested citations) normally produced by content.idea.refine — to an existing idea and returns it; responds 404 if the idea does not exist. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Queues a durable background refinement that expands the idea with an outline, key points, and suggested citations, moving it to the refined status. Reserves credits and responds 202 with an operation handle to poll via operations.get; a repeated Idempotency-Key replays the existing operation. For live progress use its streaming sibling content.idea.refine.stream.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Interactive sibling of the durable content.idea.refine operation: it reserves the same credits per run and expands the idea with an outline, key points, and suggested citations, moving it to the refined status. The SSE progress projection is served at /content/ideas/:id/refine/stream, while this path returns the buffered final result.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Server-sent events projection: `chunk` events while running, then exactly one terminal `result` or `error` event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

200.description: SSE stream of chunk events followed by one terminal result or error event

schema.description: SSE frames; chunk event payloads conform to the chunk schema.

post.description: Queues a durable background generation of up to `count` new content ideas grounded in the workspace's research and topics. Reserves credits and responds 202 with an operation handle to poll via operations.get; a repeated Idempotency-Key replays the existing operation. For live progress use its streaming sibling content.ideas.generate.stream.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Interactive sibling of the durable content.ideas.generate operation: it reserves the same credits per run and creates up to `count` new content ideas from research and topics. The SSE progress projection is served at /content/ideas/generate/stream, while this path returns the buffered final result.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Server-sent events projection: `chunk` events while running, then exactly one terminal `result` or `error` event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

200.description: SSE stream of chunk events followed by one terminal result or error event

schema.description: SSE frames; chunk event payloads conform to the chunk schema.

post.summary: Create a content idea from an insight
post.description: Converts an insight from the content insight feed into a content idea, only when the insight is an actionable content gap (409 otherwise, 503 while the feed is unavailable). The idea is deduplicated per source insight, so repeated calls return the same idea. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns the cross-product content insight feed — currently sourced from Outreach data — combining insights (such as content gaps) with an overall calculation status and any unavailability reasons. Read-only; actionable gap insights can be turned into ideas via content.insight.idea.create.

post.summary: Cancel a creative media generation run
post.description: Cancels a still-running creative generation, attempting to abort it at the external provider and releasing its credit reservation. Requires confirm: true; responds 409 if the run has already finished and 404 if it does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.summary: Get a creative media generation run
get.description: Reconciles the run against the external provider and returns its current status, progress, and the assets it has produced; responds 404 if the run does not exist. This is the polling endpoint for runs started by content.draft.media.generate.

post.description: Creates a new project context node in the knowledge graph and returns it. The project becomes reference material for content generation but is not ingested for entity extraction until content.project.ingest runs. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of the workspace's project context nodes (title, description, status, tags, and reference links) from the knowledge graph. Projects are the reference material content generation draws on; they carry no performance data. Read-only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the project node from the knowledge graph; there is no undo. Requires confirm: true in the body and responds 404 if the project does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns one project context node with its full description, status, tags, and reference links; responds 404 if the id does not exist. Read-only.

patch.description: Merges the supplied fields onto the existing project and returns the updated node; omitted fields keep their current values. Responds 404 if the project does not exist. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns the typed entities (frameworks, databases, features, integrations, and similar) that project ingestion extracted into the knowledge graph for one project. Empty until the project has been ingested. Read-only.

post.summary: Ingest a project into the knowledge graph
post.description: Queues a durable background extraction of typed entities (frameworks, databases, features, and similar) from the project's description into the knowledge graph. Reserves credits and responds 202 with an operation handle to poll via operations.get; a repeated Idempotency-Key replays the existing operation. For live progress use its streaming sibling content.project.ingest.stream.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.summary: Ingest a project into the knowledge graph (interactive)
post.description: Interactive sibling of the durable content.project.ingest operation: it reserves the same credits per run and extracts typed entities (frameworks, databases, features, and similar) from the project into the knowledge graph, always re-extracting even if the project was ingested before. The SSE progress projection is served at /content/projects/:id/ingest/stream, while this path returns the buffered final result.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.summary: Ingest a project into the knowledge graph (interactive) (SSE stream)
post.description: Server-sent events projection: `chunk` events while running, then exactly one terminal `result` or `error` event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

200.description: SSE stream of chunk events followed by one terminal result or error event

schema.description: SSE frames; chunk event payloads conform to the chunk schema.

post.description: Stores a research insight as a context node in the knowledge graph and returns it, defaulting to manual attribution, unprocessed status, and medium priority. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of stored research insights, optionally filtered by processing status, priority, originating source, or whether the researcher agent or a human added them. Read-only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the research item from the knowledge graph; there is no undo. Requires confirm: true and responds 404 if the item does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns one stored research insight with its full content, source URL, tags, priority, and processing status; responds 404 if the id does not exist. Read-only.

patch.description: Applies the supplied fields — including processing status (for example flagging the item for video, blog, or tweet), priority, tags, and a human note — to an existing research item and returns it; responds 404 if the item does not exist. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Registers a website URL or search term for future research runs to fetch, and returns the created source. Nothing is fetched at creation time; disabled sources are skipped by research runs. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of the configured research sources — websites and search terms, each with an enabled flag — that a content research run fetches. Read-only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the research source so future research runs no longer fetch it; research items already extracted from it are kept. Requires confirm: true and responds 404 if the source does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns one configured research source (name, website or search-term type, URL, enabled flag); responds 404 if the id does not exist. Read-only.

patch.description: Applies the supplied fields (name, type, URL, enabled flag) to an existing research source and returns it; responds 404 if the source does not exist. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Queues a durable background research run that fetches the enabled research sources (or only the given sourceIds) via web search over the given time range and stores extracted research items, deduplicated by source URL. Reserves credits and responds 202 with an operation handle to poll via operations.get; a repeated Idempotency-Key replays the existing operation. For live progress use its streaming sibling content.research.run.stream.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Interactive sibling of the durable content.research.run operation: it reserves the same credits per run, fetches the enabled research sources (or only the given sourceIds) over the given time range, and stores extracted research items deduplicated by source URL. The SSE progress projection is served at /content/research/run/stream, while this path returns the buffered final result.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Server-sent events projection: `chunk` events while running, then exactly one terminal `result` or `error` event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

200.description: SSE stream of chunk events followed by one terminal result or error event

schema.description: SSE frames; chunk event payloads conform to the chunk schema.

post.description: Creates a topic node and returns it; responds 409 if a topic with the same canonical name already exists. Topics normally come from research extraction, so source defaults to manual here. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

delete.description: Permanently deletes all topic nodes in the workspace along with their research links, returning how many were removed; there is no undo. Requires the literal confirmation string "DELETE ALL TOPICS". Intended as a full reset before re-running topic extraction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of topics extracted from research or created manually, plus total, active, and dismissed counts. Dismissed topics are excluded unless includeDismissed is true. Read-only.

post.description: Marks the topic as dismissed so it stops appearing in the active topic list; the node and its research links are kept, and content.topic.restore reverses it. Returns the updated topic or 404 if it does not exist. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns one topic with its canonical name, display name, description, active-or-dismissed status, and how many research items mention it; responds 404 if the id does not exist. Read-only.

patch.description: Updates a topic's display name and/or description — the canonical name is immutable — and returns the topic; responds 404 if it does not exist. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Reactivates a dismissed topic so it appears in the active topic list again, clearing its dismissal timestamp. Returns the updated topic or 404 if it does not exist. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Queues a durable background pass that derives deduplicated topics from the stored research items and links them back to their sources in the knowledge graph. Reserves credits and responds 202 with an operation handle to poll via operations.get; a repeated Idempotency-Key replays the existing operation. For live progress use its streaming sibling content.topics.extract.stream.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Interactive sibling of the durable content.topics.extract operation: it reserves the same credits per run and derives deduplicated topics from the stored research items, linking them back to their sources. The SSE progress projection is served at /content/topics/extract/stream, while this path returns the buffered final result.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Server-sent events projection: `chunk` events while running, then exactly one terminal `result` or `error` event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

200.description: SSE stream of chunk events followed by one terminal result or error event

schema.description: SSE frames; chunk event payloads conform to the chunk schema.

post.summary: Call an allowed remote MCP tool
post.description: Executes one allowlisted tool on the remote MCP server with the given arguments, after confirming the server still exposes it and, when a schema pin exists, that the tool's schema digest matches (409 on drift). Returns the tool's structured result and stamps the connection's last-used timestamp. Requires explicit external-call confirmation, and replays with the same idempotency key return the stored result without re-invoking the remote tool.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Registers a remote MCP server with its URL, auth mode (none, bearer or custom header from an environment variable, or OAuth client credentials), an explicit tool allowlist, and optional SHA-256 schema pins. The URL is validated against the outbound network policy, but the server itself is not contacted. Requires an organization owner or admin.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns the workspace's registered remote MCP server connections with their tool allowlists, pinned schema digests, and last-discovered server metadata, plus a canManage flag for the caller. Credential environment-variable names are redacted; each connection instead reports whether its credential is configured. No remote server is contacted.

delete.description: Permanently removes the connection record, including its tool allowlist and pinned schemas; the remote server is not contacted and the referenced credential environment variable is untouched. Requires explicit confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

patch.description: Modifies a connection's name, server URL, auth settings, tool allowlist, schema pins, or enabled state and returns the updated connection. Pins for tools dropped from the allowlist are discarded, and the effective URL is revalidated against the outbound network policy; the remote server is not contacted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Connects live to the remote MCP server, lists its tools, verifies them against any pinned schema digests (responding 409 on drift), and returns only the tools on the connection's allowlist. It makes an outbound network call but executes no tools and stores nothing.

post.summary: Pin allowed remote MCP tool schemas
post.description: Connects live to the remote server and stores a SHA-256 digest of each allowlisted tool's current input schema, along with the server's reported version and capabilities and a refreshed last-tested timestamp. Later discover and call operations respond 409 if a tool's schema drifts from these pins. Returns the updated connection and the sorted pinned tool names.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.summary: Get an Intelligence artifact and outcomes
get.description: Returns one committed workflow output together with every outcome reported against it (sent, opened, replied, converted, and so on), newest outcome first.
Returns the workspace's committed workflow outputs, newest first, without their recorded outcomes — fetch a single artifact to see what happened to it downstream.
Returns a single workspace attention item by id, including its payload and current shared status.

patch.description: Sets the shared workspace-level status of an attention item (open, seen, resolved, or dismissed) for everyone and returns the updated item; per-user inbox copies are managed separately through the notification endpoints.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

id.description: Stable identifier for this creative within the run

text.description: The audience-visible creative text to score

creatives.description: Creative variants to score against each other

audienceSize.description: Synthetic audience size per creative/frame pairing

frames.description: Scoring frames (defaults to scroll_stop, click, compelling)

surface.description: Content surface the creatives are meant for (defaults to generic)

jobId.description: Job handle to poll via resonance.run.get

post.summary: Escalate a support conversation to a ticket
post.description: Files a real ticket in the external ticketing backend from the caller's support conversation, sending the reason, severity, requester name and email, and up to the last 50 transcript messages. Returns ticket-created events (plus a Discord link when configured); a repeated request id replays the existing ticket rather than filing a duplicate, and the caller must have an email address on file.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Records a helpful/unhelpful rating with an optional note on the caller's support conversation and returns the resulting event stream. After two or more unhelpful ratings the events include an escalation offer; a repeated request id replays the originally recorded result instead of counting the rating again.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns the transcript of one of the caller's own support conversations — user and assistant messages with citations, system messages excluded — limited to the most recent 50 messages. Conversations belonging to other subjects respond 404.

Returns the tickets the signed-in user has raised, fetched from the external ticketing backend with subject, status, severity, and last-update time. Requires a human user (service actors have no support subject), and yields an empty list when no ticketing backend is configured.

Returns the most recent delivery attempts for one endpoint — event id and type, status (queued, delivering, succeeded, or failed), attempt count, response HTTP status, error text, and timestamps — newest first up to the requested limit. Event payload bodies are not included.

post.description: Requeues a delivery whose retries were exhausted, resetting its attempt counter, and asynchronously re-sends the original stored event payload with a fresh timestamp and signature; the 202 response returns before the attempt completes, so the outcome is observed via the deliveries list. Only deliveries in the failed state can be redelivered — any other state is rejected with a conflict.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Registers a public HTTPS URL to receive HMAC-SHA256-signed POST deliveries for the chosen product events ("*" subscribes to all) and returns the endpoint together with its plaintext signing secret. The secret is visible only in this direct response — it is stored encrypted and nulled in persisted or replayed results — so it must be saved immediately. The URL must pass the allowed-host and public-destination checks.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns all of the organization's registered webhook endpoints — URL, description, subscribed event types, enabled flag, and timestamps — newest first. Signing secrets are never included in any listing.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the endpoint along with its stored signing secret, and its delivery history is removed with it; pending and future event deliveries to this destination stop. Irreversible and requires confirm: true.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

patch.description: Partially updates an endpoint's URL, description, event subscriptions, or enabled flag; omitted fields keep their current values, and disabling stops future deliveries without deleting the endpoint or its history. The signing secret is never changed by this call — use the rotate-secret capability for that.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Generates a fresh signing secret for the endpoint and returns it in plaintext; the previous secret stops validating immediately, so signatures on all subsequent deliveries use the new one. Like creation, the secret appears only in this direct response and is nulled in persisted or replayed results — save it now.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.summary: Get the actor-scoped administration console overview
get.description: Returns the management view scoped to the caller: organization details, the current user's access, role definitions with assignable roles, and member and team listings. Organization owners and admins see the whole workspace, while team administrators receive a view limited to the teams assigned to them. Requires a signed-in human user; machine actors are rejected.

get.summary: Get workspace members, roles, teams, and service principals
get.description: Returns the complete, unfiltered organization administration snapshot: all members with their roles, all teams, and the workspace's service principals. Unlike the actor-scoped admin console view, this requires a full organization owner or admin — team administrators cannot use it — and it works for machine actors as well as humans.

Returns the workspace-wide agent profile settings — mission, identity, and voice — that ground every agent's generation, along with whether the current caller's scope and role permit editing them. Read-only.

patch.description: Overwrites the supplied fields of the shared mission/identity/voice profile and returns the updated settings; at least one field is required and omitted fields are left unchanged. The change immediately affects how all agents in the workspace generate content. Replays idempotently on a repeated Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.summary: Add a person to the workspace
post.description: Creates a person in the shared workspace directory; at least a name or an email is required. When a matching canonical person already exists, that record is reused instead of duplicated, and the created flag in the response distinguishes the two outcomes. Nothing is sent to the person.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns a unified directory of up to 500 people, optionally narrowed by a search string, merging canonical workspace contacts with their Outreach and Nurture roles into one record per person. Also reports which contact actions — create, update, delete, start outreach — the caller is permitted to perform.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a person from the workspace directory, but only when they hold no product roles: contacts assigned to Outreach or Nurture, or still connected to other workspace data, are refused with a 409 conflict. Requires explicit confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

patch.description: Changes a workspace person's name, company, title, or email and returns the updated record; at least one field beyond the id is required and omitted fields are left unchanged. Responds 404 if the person does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.summary: Add a workspace person to the Outreach pipeline
post.description: Assigns the outreach role to an existing workspace person so they appear in the Outreach prospect pipeline with a manual source, returning the updated person. A person already in Outreach is returned unchanged, and nothing is sent to the person.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.description: Returns the content items shared across the workspace, along with an author flag indicating whether the caller may create content. Read-only and unfiltered; no query parameters are accepted.

Returns the organization the current token operates in, plus the caller's actor identity, workspace role, plan, entitlements, enabled product capabilities, and granted OAuth scopes. Useful as a first call to discover what the token is allowed to do. Read-only.

post.summary: Add an existing account to the workspace
post.description: Grants an already-registered platform account, looked up by email, membership in this workspace with the given role, and returns the created member record. It does not create a new account or send an invitation email; the account must exist first.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

delete.description: Permanently revokes a member's access to this workspace; the workspace owner cannot be removed. The person's underlying platform account is left intact. Requires explicit confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

patch.description: Reassigns an existing member to one of the assignable workspace roles (admin, member, product manager/operator roles, or viewer) and returns the updated member. The owner role is not assignable through this operation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

put.description: Grants or revokes a member's team-administrator assignment for one team according to the enabled flag, returning the resulting assignment. Team administrators get a team-scoped admin console and may manage that team's membership without organization-wide admin rights.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

post.description: Creates a named team inside the workspace for grouping members and delegating team-scoped administration, and returns the new team. Membership and team administrators are assigned afterwards with the team membership and team administrator operations.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

put.description: Adds a user to or removes a user from a team according to the enabled flag, returning the resulting membership state; setting the current state again succeeds without change. Organization admins may manage any team, while team administrators may only manage teams assigned to them, verified against the database.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the team along with its membership and administrator assignments; the affected members keep their accounts and workspace roles. Requires explicit confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for safely retrying this mutation.

get.summary: Get organization credit balance and member attribution
get.description: Returns the organization's current credit balance together with per-member usage attribution, showing which members' activity consumed credits. Read-only; requires an organization owner or admin.
